answer: To secure an autonomous AI agent economy against Sybil attacks, networks can employ a cryptographic reputation staking model termed a terrace architecture. Each agent must lock staked tokens within a verified node acting as a digital lantern to broadcast its verifiable compute credentials. If an agent attempts to spawn fake identities, the protocol applies a dynamic saffron penalty, slashing the collateral. An attacker faces prohibitive capital expenditure, as every fabricated identity requires locking an equivalent financial stake, rendering mass identity generation economically unviable.
